## mcrl dashboard create

Create a dashboard.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard create [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a dashboard from flags, or from a JSON or YAML file in the API's format
with -f. Flags override the file's fields.

API: POST /api/v0/dashboards
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard create -f dashboard.yaml
  mcrl dashboard get overview --jq 'del(.id) | .urlPath = "overview-copy"' | mcrl dashboard create -f -

Flags:
  -f, --file string       JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string       memo
      --title string      title
      --url-path string   URL path, e.g. "web/overview"
```

## mcrl dashboard delete

Delete a dashboard.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard delete <dashboard>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a dashboard. The output is the deleted object.

API: DELETE /api/v0/dashboards/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard delete overview
  mcrl dashboard delete 3Ja1bAxcdef --yes
```

## mcrl dashboard edit

Edit a dashboard in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard edit <dashboard>

Open the current dashboard as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/dashboards/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl dashboard edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl dashboard get

Show a dashboard.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard get <dashboard>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a dashboard by ID or urlPath or title.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/dashboards/<id>, GET /api/v0/dashboards
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard get overview      # by URL path
  mcrl dashboard get 'Web overview'  # by title
```

## mcrl dashboard list

List dashboards.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List dashboards.

API: GET /api/v0/dashboards
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard list
  mcrl dashboard list --jq '.[] | {id, title, urlPath}'
```

## mcrl dashboard update

Update a dashboard.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl dashboard update <dashboard> [flags]

Update a dashboard. The current dashboard is fetched and the flags (and -f fields) are
applied on top, so only the fields to change need to be given. --replace
sends the -f file as the complete object instead.

API: PUT /api/v0/dashboards/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl dashboard update overview --title 'Web overview'
  mcrl dashboard update overview -f widgets.yaml

Flags:
  -f, --file string            JSON or YAML file with the fields to change ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string            memo
      --replace[=true|false]   send the -f file as the complete object without merging
      --title string           title
      --url-path string        URL path, e.g. "web/overview"
```
